message.abstract: <jats:p>Language is a great invention of human civilization, it is a way to express our thoughts and major ingredients of communication, in this same way we can communicate with machines. Now the complications come when it is about to make the machine understand our human language as the machine doesn’t understand anything except 0 &amp; 1. After mankind became able to communicate with machines to a great extent, the major problem we have been facing is attacks on language technology. In this paper, we are going to discuss these attacks more on NLP (Natural Language Processing) and ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition). NLP brings the concept of text to convert to the understand meaning and ASR converts speech to text which performs well in imitating human spoken speech. In this paper, we have reviewed various adversarial attacks level and adversarial attack examples and also we have analyzed how it makes the system fool by adding some small perturbation to the original input and their effect on day-to-day used social media applications by spreading rumors, hate speech, and misinformation on social media platform and how that sometimes causes a serious effect on our lives.</jats:p>
title: Adversarial Attacks on Language Technology and Effect on Social Media Applications
